items.t: Carnival (CCL) Unveiled Two New LNG Powered Ace Class Ships

items.t: Carnival Orders Two ~130,000-Ton Next-Generation Cruise Ships From Fincantieri’s Marghera Yard For Carnival Cruise Line, Due 2033 And 2035
CARNIVAL CRUISE LINE UNVEILS THE NEXT WAVE OF VACATIONS FROM SEA TO SHORE, INCLUDING A NEW SHIP CLASS AND EXPANSION OF CELEBRATION KEY
items.sum: Carnival Cruise Line President Christine Duffy today announced plans for two new ships that will introduce a new class to the Carnival fleet. To be built by long-time partner Fincantieri and delivered in 2033 and 2035, the approximately 130,000-gross-ton LNG-powered ships are intentionally designed on a smaller scale, enabling access to more ports and expanding destination and itinerary choices.
